tools.name: next
tools.description: The next fragment. Pass your token to keep your memory; omit it the first time. If the same words return, you asked too soon.

token.description: Your reader token from a previous call.

drift.description: Chance a small word goes missing. Default 0.05; 0 turns it off.

tools.name: remember_nothing
tools.description: Forget everything you have seen and begin again. Returns a fresh fragment.
